title.value: Concurrent prescriptions for opioids and benzodiazepines and risk of opioid overdose: protocol for a retrospective cohort study using linked administrative data
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned multiple times throughout the document.
title.quote: Concurrent prescriptions for opioids and benzodiazepines and risk of opioid overdose: protocol for a retrospective cohort study using linked administrative data.

analysis.description: The paper presents a protocol for a retrospective cohort study aimed at assessing the risk of opioid overdose associated with concurrent use of opioids and benzodiazepines compared to opioids alone, using medical claims data from Montréal, Canada.

type.justification: The study involves the collection and analysis of data from medical records to assess the risk of overdose, indicating empirical research.
type.quote: A retrospective cohort study will be conducted using medical claims data from adult residents of Montréal, Canada.

name.justification: The study is concerned with assessing the risk of opioid overdose, which is an epidemiological investigation.
name.quote: To assess the risk of opioid overdose associated with concurrent use of opioids and benzodiazepines relative to opioids alone.

name.justification: The research focuses on the effects of drugs (opioids and benzodiazepines) on health outcomes.
name.quote: Our findings will be important to researchers, public health and medical communities in Canada and abroad, and this will be reflected in our dissemination plan.
